title: Auto-detect stale compliance owners and trigger reconcile playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Compliance artifacts for SOC2/ISO and SSO/audit-log workstreams are often left in limbo when owners change roles or become inactive. This causes last-minute scramble for audit evidence, missed cutover gates, and manual reassignments during compliance windows. Goal: Build a lightweight milestone-tracking playbook that automatically detects stale compliance tasks (owner inactivity, missing progress updates, stale attachments), surfaces a ranked reconciliation queue, and executes an agreed escalation/rotation flow to remove blockers before audit gates. Success metrics: reduce 'stale' compliance tasks by 60% within two cycles, cut average evidence retrieval time from 6 days to under 48 hours, and avoid at least two release hold incidents during the next SOC2 snapshot.
approach: 1) Define heuristics for 'stale' (no updates in X days, doc link missing, blocked label present, owner inactive in org). 2) Implement detection pipeline pulling from Linear, GH PRs, Confluence doc metadata, and SSO/audit-log delivery status. 3) Present a ranked reconcile queue in Console (read-only to start) and wire Slack + email nudges. 4) Automate soft-owner-rotation after two failed nudges (create an action item and default reassignment to designated backup). 5) Add telemetry and a retrospective dashboard for OKR tracking.
phases_and_acceptance: Phase 1 (MVP): heuristic detector + weekly reconcile queue; Acceptance: queue populated with >95% precision on a seed set and Slack nudges sent. Phase 2: automated nudges and UI list; Acceptance: owner ack rates >50% for first nudge. Phase 3: automated rotation + audit gate integration; Acceptance: no audit gate failures in staging rollouts for 30 days.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: false positives may spam owners — mitigate by conservative thresholds and an opt-out 'dnd' flag. Risk: RBAC/audit concerns around automated reassignment — mitigate via auditable action logs and admin override. Risk: data gaps across sources — mitigate by progressive rollout and manual reconciliation fallback.
